subject: Volunteer check-in note
text:
Hi, the volunteer check-in is Thursday around nine a.m., but I forgot to say where: side door, not front desk. There will be clipboards, though the printer may jam if everyone signs in together. Also, the side door stays locked until a staff member buzzes us. Could you ask the team to arrive a few minutes early so we do not block the hallway or lose sign-in time?

Thanks
